div.head: ECf 11.1 A 7
div.ab:
Debet uero rex Deum timere super omnia et diligere et mandata eius per totum regnum suum seruare. Debet etiam sanctam ecclesiam regni sui cum omni integritate et libertate iuxta constitutiones patrum et
predecessorum seruare, fouere, manutenere, regere et contra inimicos defendere, ita ut Deus pre ceteris honoretur et pre oculis semper habeatur.
div.note: Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 635–636 (November 2026): read from the page images and checked against the scan’s own text layer, differences settled against the page.

This passage is not part of ECf or ECf retr: it is one of the additions of the London collection (Leges Anglorum s. XIII in. Londoniis collectae), which Liebermann prints in smaller type across the page, under ECf retr. 11, 1, and numbers 11, 1 A ff. The dictionary cites it as “ECf 11, 1 A …”, so it is kept with ECf here.
